requirements.title: Common event envelope schema
requirements.description: All events follow a common envelope: id (UUID), timestamp (ISO-8601), domain (string), event_type (string), payload (JSONB). Optional fields: is_intervention (bool), hypothesis_id (UUID).

requirements.title: PostgreSQL time-series events table
requirements.description: Events stored in lifestyle.events table with JSONB payloads. Table partitioned by time for query performance. Extensible without schema migrations when adding new domains.

requirements.title: Event indexing strategy
requirements.description: Composite index on (domain, timestamp) for efficient time-range queries. GIN index on payload for JSONB queries. Partial indexes for common query patterns.
